Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: N = (default) indicates a new order. Y = indicates an application level resend and is not supported. The message will be logged, but effectively ignored. For reasons of economy, Cboe does not track (in primary storage) the Cl Ord ID values of orders that are no longer live.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Used by a trading participant or a broker service provider to provide a broker cross reference. Reflected back on Execution Reports associated with this order. 10 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed. Available via Standard FIX Drop on an opt-in basis at the port level. Available by default on Order by Order FIX Drop.

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for double-quote (34), comma (44), “at” symbol (64), semicolon (59), and pipe (124). If the Cl Ord Id matches a live order it will be rejected as duplicate (unless Poss Resend (97) = ‘Y’, see above). Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of Cl Ord ID values among currently live orders. However, we strongly recommend keeping Cl Ord ID values day unique.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Single value only (with no trailing space) For more details on each order type, see Peg Orders. All values not defined below are ignored. P = Market Peg (peg Buy [Sell] to PBBO Offer [Bid], one tick within PBBO) R = Primary Peg (peg Buy [Sell] to PBBO Bid [Offer], one tick within PBBO) M = Midpoint (peg to PBBO Midpoint)

Field.Name: HandInst
Field.Description: Instruction for order handling. 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Identifies the symbology presented in the Symbol (55) tag. 3 = QUICK (default) 5 = RIC

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares for order, 1 to 999,999,999.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market 2 = Limit P = Pegged Market will reject unless VWAPSession ID(8004) is present. Pegged will reject unless: • Exec Inst (18) = P, R, or M.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit (or cap) Price. If Ord Type (40) is • 1 (Market) – Price is ignored (if present). • 2 (Limit) – Required Limit Price. Rejected if price is finer than the minimum trading increment for the stock. • P (Pegged) – Optional Cap Price. Rejected if price is finer than the minimum trading increment for the stock.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: The capacity for the order. A = Agency P = Principal

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell Short (client affirms ability to borrow) 6 = Sell Short Exempt

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol (upper case alphanumeric) conforming to the symbology declared in IDSource(22).

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 = DAY (default) 3 = IOC (portion not filled immediately is cancelled). 4 = FOK (an IOC where the entire size must be filled, else the order will be cancelled back). 6 = GTD (expires at earlier of specified Expire Time or end of day). • VWAP orders must be DAY or IOC • Pullback orders must be DAY or GTD

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time order initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2, but not used by Cboe.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum fill quantity is accepted only for VWAP orders (orders having VWAPSession ID(8004) populated). Multiple consecutive fills may be created such that their combined size satisfies the Min Qty requirement. Rejected if it is not an integer multiple of the standard trading unit. When the remaining size (Leaves Qty) on an order is less than the defined Min Qty, then Min Qty is set to the Leaves Qty.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Portion of Order Qty to display. Used for iceberg orders. Rejected if it is not an integer multiple of the standard trading unit. Iceberg orders are Limit orders (40=2) and require Max Floor > 0 if specified. For iceberg orders, this is the displayed quantity. The balance is reserve. The displayed quantity of each order at a price level is decremented first. Ignored if order is IOC or VWAP.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Required for Time In Force (59) = ‘6’ (GTD) orders, specifies the UTC Date/Time timestamp when the order expires. GTD orders will expire at the earlier of the end of the current trading day and the Expire Time.

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Signed currency value up to one decimal place is added to the result of the peg calculation. Ignored if Ord Type(40) is not P (Pegged).

Field.Name: CashMargin
Field.Description: Indicates the type of cash or margin order. 1 = Cash (default) 2 = Margin Open 3 = Margin Close Rejected if any other value is specified. Ignored if order is VWAP.

Field.Name: NoTradeFeat
Field.Description: Defines how to handle Match Trade Prevention (MTP) scenarios. If not specified, the port default is used. U = No Match Trade Protection, No Trade Key (7714) will be ignored. N = Cancel Newest O = Cancel Oldest B = Cancel Both S = Cancel Smallest D = Decrement larger/Cancel Smaller d = Same as ‘D’, but only decrement Leaves Qty. Do not restate Order Qty. If the older and newer orders in a self-matching trade have conflicting instructions, the instruction of the newer order will be honored, except if the inbound order specifies Decrement and the resting order does not, and the resting order is larger, then both orders will be cancelled. This exception protects the order entry software for the resting order from receiving an unexpected restatement message.

Field.Name: NoTradeKey
Field.Description: Interactions of orders from the same participant with the same No Trade Key (7714) value will be managed by the newer order’s No Trade Feat (7713) instruction. Ignored if No Trade Feat (7713)=U. Up to 10 printable ASCII characters (in the inclusive range 32..126).

Field.Name: OrderClassification
Field.Description: N Specify the order classification as a single alphanumeric character. Suggested values: 1 = Non Low Latency trading (Auto) 2 = Non Low Latency trading (Manual) 3 = Market Making Strategy 4 = Arbitrage Strategy 5 = Directional Strategy 6 = Other Strategy

Field.Name: Pullback
Field.Description: N P = Pullback Cancels back if the working price locks or crosses the effective TSE quote. Rejected unless Time In Force (59) = 0 (DAY) or 6 (GTD). Ignored unless sent to the Alpha marketplace.

Field.Name: MarginTransactionType
Field.Description: N Specifies if a margin order is a Negotiable or a Standardized. 1 = Negotiable 2 = Standardized Required if Cash Margin (544) = 2 (Margin Open) or 3 (Margin Close), otherwise ignored.

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: N P = Post Only (never take liquidity). Rejected unless Ord Type(40) = 2 (Limit) and Time In Force(59) is 0 (DAY) or 6 (GTD).
